verdict_scope: primary-paper and pinned-OSS mechanism harvest plus historical Pact Cool-Chic/C3 instance/formulation re-scope; no fresh scorer run, archive, or promotion claim

epistemic_labels.MEASURED_EXTERNAL: Measured by the cited paper or official release on its own image/video fidelity axis; never transferred as Pact score evidence.
epistemic_labels.MEASURED_LOCAL_ADVISORY: Measured in historical Pact artifacts on the stated local advisory axis.
epistemic_labels.DERIVED: Re-derived from measured or source-inspected premises without a new run.
epistemic_labels.ROUTED_PENDING: A named consumer and arbitration gate exist, but no same-object composition has been measured.
epistemic_labels.N_A: The source mechanism is a vehicle-specific means or optimizes a non-authority metric; it is not adopted into DDM.
epistemic_labels.GAP: The evidence or typed stream required to decide does not exist.
epistemic_labels.CONFLICT: The lesson conflicts with contest authority or another binding invariant unless a narrower exact A/B resolves it.

lesson_table.mechanism: Per-instance hierarchical latent grids, bicubic upsampling, a tiny synthesis MLP, and a causal Laplace ARM; the differentiable objective prices latent entropy but network bytes are selected after training.
lesson_table.measured_effect: MEASURED_EXTERNAL: the paper establishes competitive image RD with a very small decoder; historical Pact measured a steep d_seg-per-byte descent but later found the continuous ARM estimate undercounted exact bytes by 2.57x to 2.85x.
lesson_table.our_surface: #366 counted description coordinates; J8F counted-application stream; r3 physical-stream gate

lesson_table.mechanism: Learned separable upsampling, residual convolutional synthesis, and late epsilon-STE quantization preparation.
lesson_table.measured_effect: MEASURED_EXTERNAL: official paper reports about 14% average rate reduction on its image axis; the release remains a PSNR vehicle result, not DDM evidence.
lesson_table.our_surface: #532 realization gate and #366 exact-R realized acceptance

lesson_table.mechanism: Imports C3 soft-round/noise quantization and training refinements into the Cool-Chic implementation.
lesson_table.measured_effect: MEASURED_EXTERNAL release claim: 15-20% rate improvement over v2; no Pact scorer composition.

lesson_table.mechanism: Explicit motion and residual modules; dense flow, alpha masking, beta blending, and a tiny per-instance decoder.
lesson_table.measured_effect: MEASURED_EXTERNAL: disabling alpha prediction was +85.7% BD-rate and disabling beta was +10.8% on the paper axis; network share reaches about 50% at the lowest plotted rate while latents dominate as rate rises.
lesson_table.our_surface: DDM seg/pose/engine budget split and counted pose stream

lesson_table.mechanism: Receiver implementation and CPU optimization; C3-style quantization schedule in production code; progressively faster decoding.
lesson_table.measured_effect: MEASURED_EXTERNAL release claims: about 100 ms at 512x768 in v3.2 and about 720p per 100 ms in v3.3; source inspection confirms T 0.3 to 0.2 and Kumaraswamy a 2 to 1.
lesson_table.our_surface: J8F receiver-closed Step-4 timing and parse-back gate

lesson_table.mechanism: Stage-specific separable symmetric latent upsampling filters and reduced ARM work; compile-assisted encoding.
lesson_table.measured_effect: MEASURED_EXTERNAL release claim: 1-5% rate reduction and about 30% ARM complexity reduction; v3.4.1 reports up to 3x encoding speedup.
lesson_table.our_surface: r3 per-stream representation race; receiver operator precision

lesson_table.mechanism: Two explicit per-frame modules, one for motion and one for residual, with RAFT-guided motion pretraining followed by one joint video RD objective that reallocates bits across frames.
lesson_table.measured_effect: MEASURED_EXTERNAL: the paper's ablation shows motion pretraining and joint allocation both matter; neural-network rate was still omitted from the descent.
lesson_table.our_surface: DDM pose/seg/engine split; organ global water level; #366 joint objective

lesson_table.mechanism: Eight-tap sinc interpolation, 4x4 block-shared motion, and 64 finite fractional positions replace pixelwise infinite-precision bilinear motion.
lesson_table.measured_effect: MEASURED_EXTERNAL: -10.5% BD-rate versus the v4.0 warp at 214 versus 391 motion MAC/pixel; 64 fractional positions cost only +0.06% BD-rate versus infinite precision.
lesson_table.our_surface: Girod precision column; #149 subpixel placement; #532 effective-quantum calibration

lesson_table.mechanism: Wasserstein perceptual distortion and decoder-side fixed-seed common randomness.
lesson_table.measured_effect: MEASURED_EXTERNAL: human-rating and perceptual-axis gains; fixed-seed common randomness costs no image-specific payload in that codec.
lesson_table.our_surface: DDM zero-byte family only under frozen-scorer exact admission

lesson_table.mechanism: All-previous-grid inter-feature context via tiny linear IFCEs, hyperlatents used only for entropy decoding, stabilizer branches, Gaussian noise plus soft-round continuation, SOAP for tiny networks, hard-round finish, and post-training RD selection of quantized network parameters.
lesson_table.measured_effect: MEASURED_EXTERNAL: no IFCE +3.8%, no SOAP +2.8%, C3 quantization proxy +2.7%, no hyperlatent +0.5%, no stabilizer +0.4% on CLIC20; official release reports about 10x fewer iterations. Source also states network rate remains omitted from training and post-tag HEAD fixes an IFCE integerization bug.
lesson_table.our_surface: g4 free-context versus counted tiny-arm versus Bellard race; #366 continuation; J8F parse-back guard; global budget split

lesson_table.mechanism: Per-instance latent, synthesis, and entropy models; integrated Laplace bin mass; C3 soft-round plus Kumaraswamy noise continuation; hard-forward/soft-backward finish and adaptive learning-rate restarts.
lesson_table.measured_effect: MEASURED_EXTERNAL: removing soft-round costs +22.18% Kodak and +24.87% CLIC BD-rate; removing Kumaraswamy costs +3.90% and +8.06%; effects are source-axis only. Source code confirms exact bin-mass coding and full latent plus model accounting.
lesson_table.our_surface: #366 differentiable rate and quantization continuation; #532 survival gate

lesson_table.mechanism: 3D grids and patches with 65-value causal spatiotemporal context; learned previous-frame masks for the top grids.
lesson_table.measured_effect: MEASURED_EXTERNAL: temporal conditioning improves paper-axis compression; the supplement reports MAC shares, not motion/temporal bit shares.
lesson_table.our_surface: g4 temporal-class context and DDM typed stream budget split

lesson_table.mechanism: A per-instance SIREN maps coordinates to RGB; its weights are the representation.
lesson_table.measured_effect: MEASURED_EXTERNAL paper axis; source inspection shows a dtype-based parameter estimate and Torch state-dict serialization, not a contest-ready packed entropy codec; 8-bit post-quantization degrades quality.
lesson_table.our_surface: No DDM vehicle adoption; only the principle that globally acting weights need explicit precision and byte custody.

lesson_table.mechanism: A receiver-shared meta-learned SIREN plus low-dimensional, shift-only per-instance modulations; a linear map lifts modulations into hidden-layer shifts.
lesson_table.measured_effect: MEASURED_EXTERNAL: about 300x faster encoding and about 4x compression on its paper axes; 5-6 modulation bits are preferred and entropy modeling saves 8-15%. Source computes expected entropy but saves tensors rather than a contest range-coded stream.
lesson_table.our_surface: Free generic receiver plus counted tiny modulation analogy; DDM typed parameter lift

lesson_table.mechanism: Meta-learned shift modulations form a compact per-instance functional representation for downstream tasks.
lesson_table.measured_effect: MEASURED_EXTERNAL: three-step adaptation; source reports that longer adaptation can improve reconstruction while degrading latent smoothness/downstream utility, and an AR transformer is disadvantaged by ambiguous modulation ordering.
lesson_table.our_surface: Schmidhuber ordering and typed parameter-lift discipline; not a codec

scorer_derived_synergies.source_lesson: Cool-Chic/C3 optimize a differentiable integrated entropy proxy beside distortion, while exact packed bytes remain the final authority.
scorer_derived_synergies.ddm_binding: Add per-typed-stream differentiable rate to #366 proposal ranking and to J8F counted application; never optimize EV1 accounting homes as though they were physical streams.
scorer_derived_synergies.arbitration: Exact same-object parse-back bytes and realized frozen-scorer S must agree with the predicted ordering; otherwise reject and recalibrate.
scorer_derived_synergies.blocker: J8F typed descriptor-to-counted-application stream has not landed; r3 correctly reports zero composable typed actuator streams.

scorer_derived_synergies.source_lesson: C3 and Cool-Chic v5 show that the quantization continuation schedule is a first-order design variable; v5's decreasing Gaussian-noise schedule beats the C3 schedule by 2.7% on its CLIC20 axis.
scorer_derived_synergies.ddm_binding: Race exact Q8/post-int8 control against C3 soft-round/Kumaraswamy and v5 soft-round/decreasing-Gaussian proposals inside #366, with hard-forward finish and realized rollback.
scorer_derived_synergies.arbitration: Same coordinates, proposal count, bytes, seed, and exact n600 receiver/R/uint8 scorer verdict. The dr1 post-int8 win is INSTANCE-only; #532 Delta=62.74 forbids proxy-only admission.
scorer_derived_synergies.blocker: No J8F counted application stream or Step-4 same-object re-smoke exists.

scorer_derived_synergies.source_lesson: Cool-Chic v5 conditions on all already decoded grids through counted tiny linear IFCEs; C3 uses causal spatiotemporal context; the DDM roster also contains g4 free decoder-derived context and optional Bellard online learning.
scorer_derived_synergies.ddm_binding: For each signed located typed stream, race raw/no context, counted tiny ARM/IFCE, g4 free predictor context, CM/CTW, and Bellard under identical semantic bytes.
scorer_derived_synergies.arbitration: Smallest complete ZIP home with exact parse-back wins; model parameters, switch headers, and context foreign keys are counted once. Free context earns zero payload only when wholly decoder-derived.
scorer_derived_synergies.blocker: r3 has no signed located stream or free-predictor foreign key; its coder race is correctly NOT_RUN.

scorer_derived_synergies.source_lesson: Cool-Chic/C3 separate latent, synthesis, entropy, motion, and residual costs; model overhead can dominate at low rates, and v4 joint video optimization reallocates rate across frames.
scorer_derived_synergies.ddm_binding: Use one organ water level across DDM skeleton/connection/fiber/gauge/residual homes, pose stream, #366 engine parameters, and coder/context model; preserve raw and coded byte columns.
scorer_derived_synergies.equation: min Sum_i D_i(b_i) subject to Sum_i (b_i+h_i)<=B; active streams satisfy -dD_i/db_i=lambda_B after exact realization
scorer_derived_synergies.arbitration: Per-section exact packed bytes plus same-object telescoping distortion. C3 supplement MAC shares are never relabeled bit shares; unknown temporal/motion bit share remains GAP.
